subSlogan: Spoken English, Personality Development & Interview Readiness
introduction:
Global Spoken English & Personality Development Institute is a professional training institute based in Amravati, Maharashtra, dedicated to improving communication skills, spoken English, personality development and interview readiness.

We help students, graduates, job seekers and working professionals develop the communication skills and confidence required to perform better in academic, professional and real-world situations.

Our training approach focuses on practical learning, individual improvement, personalised guidance and real-life communication practice.

With a strong focus on individual requirements, we assess each candidate's current level before recommending the most suitable course and learning path.

trainer.fullBio: As the Director of Global Spoken English & Personality Development Institute, Amravati, Coach Faizan Khan has trained 15,000+ Students and Working Professionals in Spoken English, Personality Development, Public Speaking, Interview Preparation and Professional skills. His practical, learner-focused training approach helps students and professionals improve the way they speak, present themselves, communicate and perform in real-life situations.
